title: Shell paper placemats
text: Shell paper placemats. Very pretty print that I think is well represented by the photo shown... thicker than I expected - although not heavy - in my opinion.  They are paper and disposable.  Quite perfect for an outdoor affair at the beach which is how I used them!  Measurements given were accurate.

product_metadata.title: Counterart Paper Placemat, Linen Shells, 24-Pack
features: Pad of 24 paper placemats for a variety of occasions
Perfect for special parties, outdoor entertaining, or on the buffet
Made of premium paper stock with beautiful designs
Disposable and recyclable- no need for laundering
description: These paper placemats from CounterArt feature beautiful, colorful designs and offer a brilliant solution for those occasions and events that call for additional placemats for your guests, or on the buffet table. Use these disposable placemats once, then toss them into the recycle bin after your gathering- no need for laundering, ironing or storing. Made of premium paper stock and generously sized at 17 by 11 Inch, these placemats come on a pad of 24; simply tear off what you need and store the others away in the resalable bag that's included and stick them in a drawer or cupboard until the next gathering. Pad includes a diagram with valuable table setting tips for breakfast, casual lunch, casual dinner and formal dinner place settings. Choose from a wide variety of designs to find that perfect fit for different occasions. Makes a great housewarming or hostess gift.
